description: Audit a mail domain as other mail servers see it: MX, SPF (including the 10-DNS-lookup limit), DKIM, DMARC policy, PTR / forward-confirmed reverse DNS, SMTP STARTTLS on the MX hosts, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI. Use when mail lands in spam or bounces, after changing mail provider or DNS, or before tightening DMARC. Use this (not check_dns) for any email deliverability or authentication question. Returns a verdict, findings with cause and fix, and a report link.

dkimSelector.description: DKIM selector to check in addition to common ones, e.g. google, selector1, mail. Optional.

domain.description: Mail domain (the part after @), e.g. example.com

name: check_email_domain

error.description: Error code when ok is false

ok.description: false when the check could not run (see error / message)

title: Email domain check
